basis: Heartland publicly established the decline by January 31, 2024. Its consolidated income statement reports Q4 2023 GAAP operating revenue, including fuel surcharges, of $275,347,000 versus $354,923,000 in Q4 2022. Revenue fell 22.42%, below the $337,176,850 cutoff. The earliest date remains unresolved because the September 12 Morgan Stanley and November 7 Baird management remarks could not be verified. The dollar bound records the published quarterly actual.

coverage.detail: The February 3, 2023 release identifies Q4 2022 as the first full quarter consolidating Heartland Express, Millis Transfer, Smith Transport and CFI. Both fourth quarters include the acquired carriers for the full period.

The July 31 Q2 release reported $306.2 million of quarterly revenue. Management discussed weak freight demand and prospects for improving operating ratios. It supplied no numerical Q4 consolidated revenue bound.
Heartland named CEO Mike Gerdin and CFO Chris Strain for Morgan Stanley’s September 12 Laguna Conference. The notice contains no revenue forecast or replay link.
Morgan Stanley’s 2023 event instructions specify 30-minute, verbal-only fireside chats and separate investor meetings. They establish the format but do not identify what Heartland said.

The participating-companies page yielded no searchable Heartland entry. The host’s Webcasting tab at https://msevents.dealogic.com/clientportal/Conferences/Custom/List/375?menuItemId=110 returned a cache miss.

The host’s agenda page opened. Its linked schedule at https://custom.cvent.com/EF05AAE8A95C44EB869D794192540A28/files/event/a5c2597e131148b2bbf7bf942779e5e9/5dffdc476a0d49e6b73b0beb75c14c13.pdf returned a cache miss. No Heartland session audio or transcript was recovered.
The October 26 Q3 release reported $295,026,000 of quarterly revenue. Management described exiting unprofitable lanes amid weak demand. It supplied no numerical Q4 consolidated revenue bound.
Heartland announced that management would present at Baird’s November 7 Global Industrial Conference. The notice contains no revenue estimate, deck or webcast link.

Baird’s December 1 recap covers 324 presenting companies. Its four-page executive summary at https://www.rwbaird.com/siteassets/gib/pdf/ic-executive-summary-letter-nov-2023.pdf contains no searchable mention of Heartland. Baird offers the full research report by request.

Another presenter’s official event page identifies the Baird webcast series through https://wsw.com/webcast/baird71/nvt/1790256. That link returned a cache miss. Neither https://wsw.com/webcast/baird71/ nor the ticker-based candidate https://wsw.com/webcast/baird71/htld/ was accessible. A Heartland webcast URL remains unconfirmed.

Heartland’s archive links the 2023 quarterly earnings releases. Searches of issuer materials located neither conference’s remarks nor a Q3 call recording or transcript. Attempts to retrieve the historical IR page at https://web.archive.org/web/20230912/https://www.heartlandexpress.com/investors and https://web.archive.org/web/20231107/https://www.heartlandexpress.com/investors were unsuccessful.

The November 7 filing concerned executive compensation. The November 2 filing at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/799233/000079923323000044/htld-20231030.htm concerned a director appointment. Neither supplied a conference presentation.

The Q3 10-Q reported nine-month revenue of $932,111,000. Its numerical outlook concerned capital spending and disposal gains. As a later arithmetic check, full-year actual revenue of $1,207,458,000 less the nine-month actual equals $275,347,000.
The November 14 Regulation FD filing estimated a $25 million pretax gain on three terminal-property sales. The quarterly income statement records disposal gains within operating expenses.

Between the Q3 and Q4 releases, the issuer archive lists the Baird notice, a November 21 dividend and a December 18 veterans announcement. No preliminary Q4 revenue release or revised revenue range was located.

The consolidated operating-revenue row for the three months ended December 31 gives 275,347 for 2023 and 354,923 for 2022, in thousands of dollars. The release separately identifies fuel-surcharge-excluded measures as non-GAAP.

publication_date_evidence: The actual-results exhibit is dated January 31, 2024 and marked “For Immediate Release.” Item 2.02 of the February 2 Form 8-K expressly confirms that Heartland announced the quarter and year-end results on January 31: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/799233/000079923324000002/htld-20240131.htm.
